regions.today: Cloud increasing with patchy light rain and drizzle spreading northwards this evening. Light to moderate southeasterly breezes will veer southwesterly this evening.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry with a mix of cloud and clear spells, with some patchy light rain or drizzle at first. Mild with lowest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees in light to moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Dry with plenty of sunshine, after some cloudy periods in the morning. Highest temperatures of 19 to 23 degrees in light to moderate westerly breezes.
regions.solar_uv: High on Friday. Moderate to high on Saturday.
